**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Build hardware artifacts from the exact PR head**

On `pull_request` runs, the default checkout is GitHub's synthetic merge ref and `github.sha` identifies that merge commit rather than `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`. Consequently, this value embeds and names an ephemeral non-HEAD revision in the hardware-test bundle, so Product Owner results from the PR artifact cannot be attributed to the exact reviewed commit required by the repository's evidence policy. Check out the PR head explicitly and use that same SHA for the build revision, notice, and artifact name (while retaining `github.sha` for push runs).
